license: none stated (no LICENSE file in repo)
split: whole set (308 questions; op4 and op5 versions of the same questions)
text: subset (194 text-only; 114 refer to "Figure X" images not included in the release, identifiable by regex)
notes: 308 USMLE Step 2/3-style questions from Medbullets (298 unique question strings; 10 duplicates). 114 questions refer to a figure ("Figure A" etc.) that is not in the release, so they are not fully answerable from text; MedHELM uses all 308. The companion JAMA Clinical Challenge set is not released (scraper only; requires JAMA access) and is not part of this benchmark row. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used.

rendering.rule: Multiple choice (op5 file, as MedHELM uses): question, then options A-E one per line.
rendering.image_rule: question text matches \bFigures?\s+[A-Z]\b (a lettered figure such as "Figure A" or "Figures A-E"; Medbullets releases no images)
